name: Email → Todoist
_setup_notes: Import this file into n8n via Settings → Import workflow.
Required nodes to configure after import:
1. Gmail Trigger — set credentials and filter to AI inbox label
2. HTTP Request (LiteLLM) — POST to http://litellm:4000/chat/completions, model=planner
4. Wait node — approval gate; configure reviewer notification channel
5. Todoist Create Task — set credentials from TODOIST_API_TOKEN
6. SQLite Insert — write audit row to db/assistant.db jobs table
Renew Gmail watch daily via a separate scheduled workflow.
